_comment: Per-host native-admit config, installed as ~/.config/native-admission/config.json. Units are strict_suite module workers. Interim policy from agent-521 (2026-10-22): at most one suite per host and at most 4 module workers per suite. cpus_per_unit = threads / budget; a lease gets weight x cpus_per_unit CPUs (docker --cpus). c4 exception (agent-521, 2026-10-22): the SOLE authoritative integration gate may run JOBS=12, only while holding the c4 reservation (reserved_max_weight 12); everyone else is capped at max_weight 4 there too.
